exclusions: Input JSON object exclusionTrialIds, unique NCT plus eight ASCII digits; exact input bytes archived and hashed. Root must freeze authoritative ledger before acquisition.
selection: Validate every record in each fetched page, preserve exclusions, order remaining records by ISO first-results date then NCT ASCII. Once ten exist, finish their cutoff date tie by observing a strictly later date or pagination exhaustion. Select first ten or all zero through nine on exhaustion. No selection on any failure or budget exhaustion before tie completion/exhaustion.
metadataProjection: protocolSection containing exactly identificationModule, statusModule, conditionsModule. Save complete selected projection per ID. Subsequent authorized outcome retrieval must have structurally equal requested metadata projection, including types, null versus missing, array order and string contents; object key order is immaterial. Separately require selected identity/date equality and preserve independent raw response hashes. Raw metadata-page bytes and full study response bytes are not expected to be equal.
transportClarification: Body-byte caps govern received entity bodies, excluding response headers and transport framing. Identity encoding requested and required. No retries or redirects. Declared oversized body is rejected before acquisition. Undeclared bodies are read only up to remaining byte capacity; reaching it fails with an explicitly incomplete diagnostic prefix, even when actual body might end exactly at cap. Complete sources cannot be guaranteed for arbitrary oversized bodies without violating cap; incomplete bodies never qualify as source frames. Partial failure bytes, headers, URLs, UTC times, hashes and receipt are retained.
scope: Metadata-only frozen observed acquisition-time frame, not atomic live database snapshot; undetectable pagination insertion/update drift cannot be ruled out. No outcome acquisition, classification, oracle or agreement claim.
sourceInspection: Pinned cached official files verified by SHA256; OpenAPI permits comma-delimited fields and date sort; metadata maps resultsFirstPostDateStruct.date to ResultsFirstPostDate. Prior executable not located; no invented dependency.
failurePolicy: Stop without outcomes or reselection on identity/date, duplicate, nonmonotone ordering, metadata shape, token, access or budget failure. Retain all acquired evidence and failure receipt. Undetectable drift remains limitation, not presumed absent.
storage: Execution requires fresh output directory and at least 10 GiB plus 20 MiB free. No headroom bypass CLI; injected transport/headroom override exists only for synthetic unit tests.
